grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login or existing driving licence details
grants.purpose: To confirm you are the licence holder requesting the name change

grants.description: Share evidence of your legal name change
grants.purpose: DVLA requires original legal documents proving your name change to update your driving licence

grants.description: Confirm your current address for delivery of the new licence
grants.purpose: The new photocard licence will be posted to this address

grants.description: Share a recent passport-type photo (required if you have a paper licence or are updating your photo)
grants.purpose: DVLA will use this photo for your new photocard licence if you currently have a paper licence or are updating your photo

grants.description: Provide details of your current driving licence
grants.purpose: To identify your current licence and transfer all entitlements to the new licence with your updated name

grants.description: Share payment information if a fee applies (£17 for photo change or £20 for lost/stolen licence)
grants.purpose: To process the fee for photo change or replacement of lost/stolen licence

revocation.mechanism: Contact DVLA by phone on 0300 790 6801 or in writing before sending your application
revocation.effect: Application will be cancelled if consent is revoked before submission. You cannot revoke consent after DVLA has received your documents and old licence.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make payment on your behalf without explicit confirmation. Agent cannot submit the application without your final approval of all details. Agent cannot send your original documents — you must post these yourself to DVLA. Agent cannot change the legal name on your evidence documents.
